causal_conclusions: The only predeclared source-expression change causes different RTM instruction scheduling/register choices and float denominator forms in this reduction. This does not identify a compiler pass or original source.
The numeric local does not guarantee a live numeric row at the byte load: RTM forms a pointer in both controls.
Same96-byte aligned extent hides different90/85-byte decoded bodies and reference placement. Size alone cannot support equality.
Both have one compiler __ftol reference and one zero float constant of the same four-byte payload; only their positions differ. No library function or literal provider is reconstructed here.
